```{=html}
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@fontsource/maple-mono@5.2.5/index.min.css">

<style>
.sct-outer {
  width: fit-content;
  margin: 1em auto;
  border: 1.5px solid #5654A2;
  border-radius: 14px;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.sct-header {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 200px 200px;
  background: #5654A2;
  text-align: center;
}
.sct-header-cell {
  font-family: 'Maple Mono', monospace;
  font-size: 0.85em;
  font-weight: bold;
  color: #F8F7F0;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  padding: 10px 16px;
}
.sct-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 200px 200px;
  align-items: stretch;
  border-top: 1px solid #D4D3EE;
  text-align: center;
}
.sct-label {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 10px 16px;
  font-family: 'Maple Mono', monospace;
  font-size: 0.88em;
  border-right: 1px solid;
}
.sct-value {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 10px 16px;
  font-family: 'Maple Mono', monospace;
  font-size: 0.88em;
}
/* Light Blue row */
.sct-row-blue .sct-label {
  background: #D6EAF8;
  color: #1A5276;
  border-right-color: #A9CCE3;
}
.sct-row-blue .sct-value {
  background: #EBF5FB;
  color: #2471A3;
}
/* Dark Green row */
.sct-row-green .sct-label {
  background: #D5F5E3;
  color: #1D6A3A;
  border-right-color: #A9DFBF;
}
.sct-row-green .sct-value {
  background: #E9F7EF;
  color: #1E8449;
}
/* Bright Red row */
.sct-row-red .sct-label {
  background: #FADBD8;
  color: #922B21;
  border-right-color: #F1948A;
}
.sct-row-red .sct-value {
  background: #FDEDEC;
  color: #C0392B;
}
</style>

<div class="sct-outer">
  <div class="sct-header">
    <div class="sct-header-cell">Display Label</div>
    <div class="sct-header-cell">Database Value</div>
  </div>
  <div class="sct-row sct-row-blue">
    <div class="sct-label">Light Blue</div>
    <div class="sct-value">light_blue</div>
  </div>
  <div class="sct-row sct-row-green">
    <div class="sct-label">Dark Green</div>
    <div class="sct-value">dark_green</div>
  </div>
  <div class="sct-row sct-row-red">
    <div class="sct-label">Bright Red</div>
    <div class="sct-value">bright_red</div>
  </div>
</div>
```
